notes.title: Small hotfix (Version 1.6)
notes.content:
Helloooooo! Halloween is almost here and to celebrate this event, we are releasing a hotfix for the demo.

Enjoy!

Patch notes:

 Some minor gameplay improvements;
 Several minor bugs fixed;
 Totally reworked the secret ending, now it’s kinda easier to get (but still this is a very SECRET ending so keep your eyes peeled!).

That's it. Happy Halloween everyone and may the ghosts be with you! 👻

notes.title: DEMO 1.5
notes.content:
Fixed some minor bugs;
 Slightly reworked a staircase puzzle to make it a little less confusing and more intuitive.

notes.title: Updates, updates, updates!
“Pseudo-Psy Play PARTI” Has Launched!
notes.content:
Pseudo-Psy Play PARTI (a.k.a Pseudo-Psy Play Demo) showcases the Prologue and the very beginning of the Chapter I. As Joseph Urban you must survive this nightmare and find Rose Underwood.

FEATURES:


 3 Tarot cards, each with unique stats;

 7 endings;

 ~40 min. on one playthrough.

https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42628782/9c268b73d454804abbcd105f0f3a64c25fec4953.png
We remind you that our Pseudo-Psy Play combines a side-scrolling shooter and a point-and-click adventure in one hell of a cocktail.

Play A Play.
